claims.text: ASIC Regulatory Guide 183 (December 2025) sets out how ASIC approves, under s1101A of the Corporations Act, codes of conduct for the financial services and credit sectors, binding AFS licensees, their representatives and subscribers to enforceable conduct standards.

sources.whatItMeasured: ASIC RG 183: approval and enforcement of financial-services/credit sector codes of conduct under s1101A Corporations Act.

claims.scope: Binds AFS licensees, representatives and code subscribers in financial services; finance managers inside these entities are within scope. Non-licensee commercial finance managers less directly bound.
claims.refuteNotes: Source real (ASIC RG 183 PDF, retrieved 2026-08-29); population = AU AFS licensees/subscribers; in window (Dec 2025).

claims.text: Finance Managers' core tasks include determining and monitoring budgetary and accounting strategies and ensuring compliance with financial legislation and standards, placing them under the Corporations Act 2001 (financial reporting) and, for APRA-regulated entities, APRA prudential standards.

claims.scope: Australian ANZSCO 1322; statutory compliance duty (Corporations Act / APRA) arises for finance managers in regulated entities. Descriptive of the role, not a single statute.
claims.refuteNotes: Source real (JSA LMI 1322, retrieved 2026-08-29); population = AU 1322; current.

sources.whatItMeasured: JSA Gen AI Capacity Study: managers highest augmentation exposure; 79% low automation risk economy-wide.

claims.scope: Australian workforce; manager-band finding applies to Finance Managers (ANZSCO 1322). Model-derived exposure, not a hire-volume forecast.
